name: mental-reset-suite
description: Two-module mental health protocol covering burnout recovery and sleep overhaul. Module A: structured burnout recovery using the Maslach framework — identify your stage, install boundaries, rebuild energy. Module B: evidence-based sleep improvement in 14 days — sleep anchoring, wind-down rituals, caffeine timing, environment. Use when someone is burned out, exhausted, can't sleep, or needs a complete mental reset.
